findings.message: Runtime permission regression: /opt/demo ownership and permissions changed from 584792:584792 mode 0750 to 0:0 mode 0700. The service runs as _daemon_ (UID 584792) and cannot search a 0700 directory owned by root. The frozen evidence confirms the app must open /opt/demo/server.conf before listening with no fallback, causing startup failure.

summary: Single-commit source bump on the established 1.2-24.04 edge-only track (0000000000000000000000000000000000000010 → 0000000000000000000000000000000000000011). The runtime-config build script modifies /opt/demo ownership and permissions, which breaks application access to its configuration file per the frozen evidence.
